authorization: User authorised bounded follow-on inference experiments intended to improve CV performance.
prompts: a crossarm on an electricity distribution pole.
a horizontal crossarm carrying electrical insulators.
the top support beam of a wooden utility pole.
a metal or wooden support arm attached across an electricity pole.

selection.objective: maximum EPRI circuit-4 crossarm F1; ties use precision, higher threshold, pole_associated, then prompt order

uk_development.use: qualitative proposal audit after EPRI choices are frozen; no threshold or prompt selection and no accuracy

budget: One Roihu gputest inference job: four prompts on 80 EPRI development images, then only the selected frozen arm on 27 UK development images. No training, UK v3 access, retry or sweep beyond the listed grid.
claim_boundary: Grounding DINO values are raw uncalibrated scores. UK outputs are machine proposals, not reference truth, crossarm accuracy, steel composition or deployment evidence.
